classification: Backward-compatible agent and developer API fail-closed security hardening
receiptImpact: No signed receipt layout, semantic profile, registry release, signer role or active partner policy changes
activationRule: Paid v1 developer routes always require API-key admission and metering; agent execution gates fail closed on unknown or unsafe evidence from either trade leg. Existing partner policy ids and activation mappings remain unchanged.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: The v5-only production policy, execution profile, receipt schema and partner verification routes are unchanged; SDK receipt recovery only prevents duplicate transaction retries after broadcast.
The production-disabled v2-v4 snapshot-relative verification contract is unchanged and no historical receipt bytes or admission rules are modified.
The pinned AEB option 2 contract and pre-trade binding format are unchanged; unsafe destination evidence can no longer produce an execution handle.
The frozen external-evidence/v0 rev6 adapter and its pinned OracleSafetyCheck v2 carrier are unchanged.
The OracleSafetyCheck v2 and pre-trade envelope wire formats are unchanged; provider selection now validates and evaluates one consistent evidence universe.
Attester key roles, registry admission and OracleSafetyCheck v3 layout are unchanged; unknown response verdicts now fail closed in the public SDK.

ThoughtProof pre-trade v2.1 and Oracle Watch signed layouts are unchanged; targetProviders now scopes freshness, agreement, quorum, independence and observations consistently, preserving the locked no-single-provider gate.
Existing receipt-adjacent durable records, schema bytes, key evidence and registry references remain unchanged.
The read-only methodology exchange, query window, dataset digest and production-disabled policy are unchanged.
